agribusiness-food-systems.summary: Farmers produce the crop. Input suppliers, traders, processors, and logistics companies earn money at different points between the farm and the customer.
trends: Precision farming
Growers use sensors, guidance, and analytics to target input use.

Elevators, ports, and cold chains connect seasonal production to buyers and shape delivered cost.

agribusiness-food-systems.question: Which step in the chain has the most bargaining power when freight costs rise?

Duration

Project risk

carbon-capture-storage.question: Which party carries the risk if captured volumes come in below the pipeline commitment?
